title: Groundbreaking Women
paragraphs: Dr. Chris Bacchi of Marin Medical Aesthetics is featured in the April 2021 issue of Marin Living. Read about how Dr. Chris Bacchi runs a successful clinic and is inspiring the next generation of “Groundbreaking Women”.
